title: The colors red, blue and yellow in Polanski's Rosemary's Baby

commenti.body: I've seen the film several times and never noticed any overt patterns of red, blue, or yellow - certainly not "a lot" of these colors, as I'm struggling to even think of what you're talking about other than maybe the color of the clothes Rosemary might be wearing. I do remember the distinct red dress or outfit being worn by her in the dream sequence, but that's about it.

It's the color if the sets and the background images and things like that. Either through the actual color of the pieces or with lighting.

It sometimes is a cold metallic blue and towards the end their apartment eventually becomes so saturated in yellow hues that it's was all I could notice.

I wish I had images for what I'm referencing. But unfortunately I don't at the moment.
